title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman: My Hotshot Disciples Are All Grown Up Now, and They Won’t Leave Me Alone
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Beryl Gardinant has quietly run his father's fencing dojo in a remote village for about twenty years. His former pupil Allusia, now commander of the kingdom's knights, recommends him as their special instructor, and he moves to the capital. There he keeps reuniting with accomplished former students, many of them young women, and defeats top fighters while remaining convinced he is an ordinary country swordsman.
life_message: Patient teaching and humble mastery bear fruit in the people you train, even if you never recognize your own worth.

content.note: Sword duels and monster fights (AniList Swordplay, Goblin, Dungeon; Manga Bookshelf). Cap at 3 (to verify gore).
